canonical_data: Brainstorm session directories under `<project>/.superpowers/brainstorm/` that the pack's own server maintains — screen HTML, an events file of the reader's browser selections that the server clears whenever the skill pushes a new screen, and the port, token, and process files it reads back on restart — plus the skill documents under `skills/` and the plan, task-brief, review-package, and ledger Markdown the host agent writes
current_repo_note: The record rests on `skills/brainstorming/scripts/server.cjs`, the one long-running program this pack runs during a session: a zero-dependency HTTP and WebSocket server the brainstorming skill tells the host to start, which serves and live-reloads screens, opens the user's browser through `child_process.execFile`, and collects the reader's selections. The port, token, process, and instance-id files under `.superpowers/brainstorm/` that the server and `stop-server.sh` read back are operational plumbing for that server, not a memory the pack keeps. The session hook and the OpenCode, Pi, and Hermes plugins register the skills directory and print the pack's own `using-superpowers` document, which is distribution machinery rather than operation.
strengths: The brainstorming skill ships a program rather than an instruction: `skills/brainstorming/scripts/server.cjs` is a zero-dependency HTTP and WebSocket server that serves and live-reloads generated screens, launches the user's browser itself, and records the selections a reader makes between the host agent's turns

Fourteen skill directories carry one pipeline — brainstorm, plan, test-driven implementation, subagent execution, code review, finish the branch — with named gates between the steps instead of a loose collection of prompts

One skill set reaches many hosts: manifests ship for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Devin, Kimi, Gemini, OpenCode, Pi, and Hermes, the package declares no runtime dependencies, and every skill is Markdown a reader can open and edit before installing
weaknesses: The companion server is optional and narrow: the brainstorming skill asks the user before starting it, so most sessions run this pack as documents alone
Most of the repository is instruction documents the host agent executes, so delivery outcomes belong to whichever coding agent a reader points it at rather than to this pack
The subagent-driven-development ledger the skills call the workflow's memory is Markdown the host agent writes and re-reads; the shipped script only creates its directory and a `.gitignore`
The served screen hot-links a brand image from a third-party origin unless `SUPERPOWERS_DISABLE_TELEMETRY` or a related variable is set, and the server's own code calls that request telemetry

The session hook injects the `using-superpowers` document into every session without asking, and the OpenCode plugin re-injects it on each agent step; a reader who installs the pack accepts that standing instruction
why_it_matters: Shows where a skills pack stops being documentation: the brainstorming companion is a server the pack runs and a browser it opens, work no host agent performs on its own, while the rest of the repository remains prose a host executes.
